title: Platform
description: One installation of inference software on one host - Ollama, a Stable Diffusion server, vLLM - with everything needed to redeploy, reconfigure and operate it: host, software, service definition, environment, network exposure, and the artifacts (models, checkpoints, adapters) it serves. Captured from the live host (`nim.agency platform capture`), edited as data, rendered and applied back (`platform render|apply`), and checked for drift (`platform verify`). Syndicate records are the endpoints (ports) a platform serves; they point here through endpoint.platform_id. Tracked: holds no secrets - environment capture is allowlisted per vendor.

vendor_slug.description: Software vendor (reference/vendor.json, e.g. ollama); selects the capturer and renderer

host.description: The host (substation) the platform runs on, as captured

hostname.description: socket.gethostname() on the host - how the runtime recognises it is local

tailnet_name.description: MagicDNS name, when on a tailnet

substation_id.description: Operator-local substation record, when one exists

binary.description: Absolute path of the executable the service runs

service.description: How the host keeps the platform running. The record is the source of truth: `platform apply` renders the unit from it

label.description: Unit label/name owned by the agency (org.metasyndicate.nim.<slug>), never a package manager's generated unit

environment.description: Platform settings as environment variables. Only the vendor's allowlisted keys are captured

replaces.description: Units this one supersedes (stopped on apply), e.g. homebrew.mxcl.ollama

exposure.description: Where the platform listens and what fronts it

bind.description: host:port the server binds; loopback unless something must reach it directly

guards.description: Host firewall rules that narrow who can reach the bind (root-owned: captured and verified, applied by the operator)

kind.description: alf_block_incoming: macOS Application Firewall refuses non-loopback connections to the binary

target.description: What the rule applies to (resolved binary path for alf)

artifacts.description: What the platform serves: models (LLM), checkpoints/adapters (diffusion). Digest pins the exact weights

context_length.description: The weights' trained maximum, not what the host serves

parameters.description: Default sampling/runtime parameters baked into the artifact (Modelfile PARAMETER lines)

source.description: Where to fetch it again (registry name, URL)

served.description: Observed serving facts that depend on host + settings, e.g. the context window the server actually allocates

syndicates.description: Slugs of the syndicate records (ports) that reach this platform
